supersession_reason: RAVEL found indirect outer-fold influence in the R1 crossfit health court: scores in other folds could have used the target fold as local training data. R2 validates calibration with the entire outer test fold excluded from local and familywise-reference score construction. No fresh-vintage outcomes had been read.

future_scoring_rule.attempt_statistic: Maximum local tail_score over all eligible phase-line objective and anchor channels in one official attempt.
future_scoring_rule.crossfit: Deterministic 5-fold split by SHA-256 of official-attempt key and R1.9 salt. Each held-out attempt is scored only against reference envelopes from the other four folds.
future_scoring_rule.multiplicity_conditioning: Familywise reference is conditioned by eligible feature-count bin: 1-8, 9-12, 13-16, 17+ when bin n>=300; otherwise global. Method×feature-count may be used only when n>=300 and is predeclared before execution; fallback order is method×count -> count -> method -> global with n>=300 for non-global levels.
future_scoring_rule.future_familywise_p: For a fresh attempt, score against the full sealed historical local reference, then compute add-one upper-tail probability against the sealed cross-fitted historical attempt-statistic reference at the highest supported multiplicity-conditioning level.
future_scoring_rule.calibration_health_gate: Across five held-out folds, empirical primary-alpha exceedance must lie in [0.003,0.02] overall; secondary-watch exceedance must lie in [0.025,0.08]. These are engineering calibration-health bands, not hypothesis-test acceptance regions.
